topic: Stanley Milgram 1961-1963 Yale Switch Experiment, 65% Baseline vs 4th-Prod Refusal & Rebel Peers (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Yale Interaction Laboratory climax where volunteers refuse the bare fourth order ('You have no other choice') and 36 of 40 defy authority when two peers stand up and quit.

clips.attire_and_hands: pale-blue shirt sleeves and a right matte low-poly hand hovering over a beige steel switch box on an oak desk
clips.prop_action: the low-poly hand reaches forward and traces lightly above thirty smooth blank silver toggle switches lined up in a straight horizontal row
clips.consequence: warm overhead daylight glints cleanly across the thirty polished toggle tips

clips.environment: an elevated rear view of a bright 1961 Yale laboratory room with pale-oak paneling, sunlit high windows, and a wide beige toggle console on a wooden table
clips.action: viewed strictly from behind, a clothed low-poly volunteer in a pale-blue shirt and tan slacks steps up to the oak chair and places both hands on the desk edge

clips.environment: a sunlit adjoining test room with cream plaster walls, a sturdy oak armchair, and soft leather wrist straps
clips.action: viewed strictly from behind, a clothed low-poly researcher in a gray technician coat steps beside a seated figure in a tweed vest and places a leather strap neatly over his wrist

clips.attire_and_hands: gray coat cuffs fastening a smooth brass wrist clip onto tweed shirt sleeves
clips.prop_action: both low-poly hands press the tan leather strap buckle closed and slide a small round brass contact onto the wrist cuff
clips.consequence: a coiled black cord hangs loosely beside the wooden armrest

clips.analogy_world: a sunlit cream wall panel mounting a round ivory rotary dimmer dial beside a warm amber glass bulb
clips.comparison_action: a low-poly hand in pale-blue shirt sleeves grips and turns the ivory dimmer knob clockwise one notch as the warm bulb brightens

clips.attire_and_hands: pale-blue shirt sleeves and cuffs extending from bottom frame before the long row of thirty blank silver toggles
clips.prop_action: the right low-poly hand reaches to the left end of the row and glides slowly rightward past switch after switch

clips.analogy_world: a sunlit light-oak seminar table holding a neat stack of ninety-nine matte ivory discs beside a single thin silver dime

clips.environment: a bright 1961 Yale stone courtyard with pastel-brick archways, autumn elms, and a sunny walkway leading to the laboratory entrance
clips.action: viewed strictly from behind, clothed low-poly men in hats and trench coats walk steadily along the stone path and step through the oak doorway

clips.attire_and_hands: pale-blue shirt cuffs with a small brass wrist contact wired to the third metal toggle switch

clips.structure: a clean pastel architectural side-by-side cutaway of the two Yale rooms divided by a solid cream center partition wall

clips.attire_and_hands: tweed vest sleeves resting calmly unstrapped beside a spinning pastel magnetic tape reel on a side table
clips.prop_action: a low-poly hand in tweed cuffs flips the unhooked wrist strap aside and presses play on the compact wooden tape deck

clips.attire_and_hands: gray technician coat cuffs holding an upturned felt hat before pale-blue shirt sleeves
clips.prop_action: the volunteer's low-poly hand reaches into the upturned gray felt hat and lifts out one folded cream paper slip

clips.attire_and_hands: pale-blue shirt cuffs extending from bottom frame over the sunlit oak table

clips.attire_and_hands: pale-blue shirt cuffs over the middle section of the thirty-switch metal row

clips.structure: a small four-quadrant frosted glass answer indicator box perched atop the beige switch console
